constraints.ocl:
context License
inv: (self.customer.license.isValid = true) and (self.number <> null)

context Branch
inv: self.vehicles->any(x | x.year >= 1) <> null

context Branch
inv: if self.vehicleCount < self.capacity then self.vehicleCount else self.capacity endif >= 49

context Payment
inv: self.discount <= self.amount and self.amount <= self.tax

context Payment
inv: self.discount <> null and self.tax <> null

context Payment
inv: self.discount <> null implies self.amount <> null

context Payment
inv: self.amount <> null implies self.tax <> null

context Branch
inv: (self.vehicleCount <= self.staffCount and self.staffCount <= self.capacity) and (not(self.vehicleCount <= self.staffCount and self.staffCount <= self.capacity))

context Branch
inv: ((self.latitude <= 100) and (self.vehicles->forAll(v | v.mileage < 50))) and (not((self.latitude <= 100) and (self.vehicles->forAll(v | v.mileage < 50))))

context Branch
inv: ((self.latitude < 1000) and (self.reservations->forAll(v | v.estimatedCost < 1000))) and (not((self.latitude < 1000) and (self.reservations->forAll(v | v.estimatedCost < 1000))))

context Branch
inv: ((self.vehicleCount <> null) = (self.staffCount <> null)) and (not((self.vehicleCount <> null) = (self.staffCount <> null)))

context Reservation
inv: ((self.customer <> null) and (self.estimatedCost < 16)) and (not((self.customer <> null) and (self.estimatedCost < 16)))

context Vehicle
inv: ((self.tankLevel > 1) and (self.reservations->forAll(v | v.estimatedCost > 2))) and (not((self.tankLevel > 1) and (self.reservations->forAll(v | v.estimatedCost > 2))))

context Branch
inv: ((self.company <> null) and (self.staffCount <> self.capacity)) and (not((self.company <> null) and (self.staffCount <> self.capacity)))

context Payment
inv: (self.rental <> null) and (not(self.rental <> null))

context License
inv: ((self.customer <> null) and (self.number.toLowerCase() = 'test')) and (not((self.customer <> null) and (self.number.toLowerCase() = 'test')))

context Reservation
inv: (self.createdAt <> null and self.confirmedAt <> null) and (not(self.createdAt <> null and self.confirmedAt <> null))

context License
inv: ((self.customer <> null) and (self.expiry.size() >= 4)) and (not((self.customer <> null) and (self.expiry.size() >= 4)))

context Branch
inv: ((self.monthlyRevenue < 1000) and (self.vehicles->forAll(v | v.seats <= 50))) and (self.monthlyRevenue > 1005)

context Branch
inv: (self.capacity + self.vehicleCount > 53) and (not(self.capacity + self.vehicleCount > 53))

context Company
inv: (self.branches->collect(x | x.reservations)->size() >= 3) and (not(self.branches->collect(x | x.reservations)->size() >= 3))

context Rental
inv: (self.mileageEnd <> self.mileageStart) and (not(self.mileageEnd <> self.mileageStart))
